item.title: Dark truth behind New York’s 29-story windowless skyscraper and why people think it’s hiding something
item.description: In the heart of Manhattan, a 550-foot tower with no windows has captured public imagination for decades. Once a Cold War-era AT&T telephone switching hub built to survive a nuclear blast, the building now fuels speculation about digital infrastructure and surveillance. With multiple similar AT&T sites across the US, the mystery persists, partly because these structures were designed to operate silently, and stay unseen.

item.title: Alabama man who filmed himself abusing a child sentenced to 965 years in prison for 84 child sex abuse offences
item.description: A Deatsville man, Jason Hudson, received a staggering 965-year prison sentence for 84 child sex crime convictions. The jury found him guilty of heinous offenses including rape, sodomy, incest, and producing child pornography. Authorities uncovered disturbing evidence of abuse and torture. His wife also pleaded guilty to related charges.

item.title: ‘Strong brotherhood in a dark place’: Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs organises Thanksgiving dinner for 1,000 inmates in prison
item.description: Sean "Diddy" Combs organized a Thanksgiving meal for approximately 1,000 inmates at FCI Fort Dix, where he is serving a 50-month sentence. Working with an inmate group, Combs used commissary purchases and improvised tools to prepare and distribute food, aiming to ensure everyone had something to eat during the holiday.

item.title: Cuffem comes back to Kick following hospitalization from Playboi Carti show fall
item.description: Popular streamer Cuffem has returned to Kick after a serious head injury sustained during a Playboi Carti concert. Cuffem expressed gratitude for his survival and plans a cautious return to streaming with ongoing medical care.

item.title: Nick Fuentes fires back as Marjorie Taylor Greene links herself to Charlie Kirk assassination in wild claim
item.description: Marjorie Taylor Greene's assertion of potential assassination, likening her fate to Charlie Kirk's, sparked online debate. Nick Fuentes reacted with a terse three-word message, later expressing support for Greene's departure, citing her stance on Israel and the Epstein files. Donald Trump criticized Greene, but she denied his claims, suggesting his opposition to the Epstein file release motivated his attack.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk controversy explained: Inside her statements on Erika Kirk, Emmanuel Macron and mystery around his death
item.description: Candace Owens is raising questions about the death of Charlie Kirk. She alleges involvement of French President Emmanuel Macron and foreign forces. News groups and fact-checkers state no proof exists for these claims. French officials have denied the allegations. Candace Owens continues to post new theories, creating a significant controversy.

item.title: Anthony Sargon faces huge backlash after attacking Asmongold’s late father in viral stream rant
item.description: Streamer Anthony Sargon ignited a firestorm by disparaging Asmongold's late father on a November 26, 2025 broadcast. The insensitive remarks, made during a discussion on streamer honesty, drew widespread condemnation for being cruel and attention-seeking. Asmongold, however, responded with remarkable composure, turning the incident into content for his own stream, impressing viewers with his dignified reaction.

item.title: CaseOh blows up on Twitch after ChatGPT suggestion, internet explodes over his ‘10 years back’ rant
item.description: Twitch streamer CaseOh publicly expressed frustration with ChatGPT on November 27, 2025, preferring Google searches. His outburst, captured in a viral clip, ignited a widespread online debate about AI versus traditional search methods. While some viewers supported his stance on curiosity, others mocked his reaction, questioning his understanding of AI's information sources.

item.title: What really happened between SteveWillDoIt and Ryan Garcia? A big claim made their controversy blow up
item.description: YouTuber SteveWillDoIt is embroiled in a public dispute with boxer Ryan Garcia, accusing Garcia of attempting to pursue his girlfriend after receiving a $150,000 watch. This controversy follows Steve's recent appearance on the Impaulsive podcast and precedes his highly anticipated YouTube return. Steve denies Garcia's claims about his children and warns Garcia against further confrontation.

item.title: Candace Owens hits back at TPUSA Faith pastors who called her evil and demonic while raising new questions about Charlie Kirk
item.description: Candace Owens is facing backlash from TPUSA after questioning Charlie Kirk's death, with a pastor calling her "evil." Owens retorted, mocking the pastor's remarks and agreeing with a young attendee who described a TPUSA Faith event as "weaponized hate." Owens also revealed Kirk's alleged final message about fearing for his life, criticizing TPUSA's silence.

item.title: ‘He doesn’t have the pulse of Republicans’: Katie Miller clashes with Bakari Sellers over Nick Fuentes — watch
item.description: A heated CNN debate erupted between Bakari Sellers and Katie Miller over Nick Fuentes' influence in the Republican Party. Sellers argued Fuentes, a misogynistic and antisemitic figure, still resonates with the base. Miller countered, accusing Democrats of using Fuentes to divide Republicans and defended JD Vance's stance. The discussion also touched on accusations of racism against Miller herself.
